description: This file defines a PHP class EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams within the OrangeHRM project, specifically in the PIM plugin. The class extends a generic FilterParams class and provides specific filtering parameters for employee work experience searches, including sorting options and employee number filtering.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) class for encapsulating search filter parameters related to employee work experience, including sorting fields and employee number.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets the default sort field to 'we.jobTitle'.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number used as a filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.
